fullPassage: From an early age, we assign purpose to objects and events, preferring this reasoning to random chance. Children assume, for instance, that pointy rocks are that way because they don't want you to sit on them. When we encounter something, we first need to determine what sort of thing it is. Inanimate objects and plants generally do not move and can be evaluated from physics alone. However, by attributing intention to animals and even objects, we are able to make fast decisions about the likely behaviour of that being. This was essential in our hunter-gatherer days to avoid being eaten by predators. The anthropologist Stewart Guthrie made the point that survival in our evolutionary past meant that we interpret ambiguous objects as agents with human mental characteristics, as those are the mental processes which we understand. Ambiguous events are caused by such agents. This results in a perceptual system strongly biased towards anthropomorphism. Therefore, we tend to assume intention even where there is none. This would have arisen as a survival mechanism. If a lion is about to attack you, you need to react quickly, given its probable intention to kill you. By the time you have realized that the design of its teeth and claws could kill you, you are dead. So, assuming intent, without detailed design analysis or understanding of the physics, has saved your life.

det.analysis:
❌ ① ignore: ignore(무시하다)는 의미가 다름
✅ ② decide: decide(결정하다)는 determine(판단하다/결정하다)의 동의어 ←정답
❌ ③ delay: delay(미루다)는 의미가 다름

det.tip: determine = decide = work out = 판단하다/결정하다

questions.passage: From an early age, we assign purpose to objects and events, preferring this reasoning to random chance. Children assume, for instance, that pointy rocks are that way because they don't want you to sit on them. When we encounter something, we first need to determine what sort of thing it is. Inanimate objects and plants generally do not move and can be evaluated from physics alone. However, by attributing intention to animals and even objects, we are able to make fast decisions about the likely behaviour of that being. This was essential in our hunter-gatherer days to avoid being eaten by predators. The anthropologist Stewart Guthrie made the point that survival in our evolutionary past meant that we interpret ambiguous objects as agents with human mental characteristics, as those are the mental processes which we understand. Ambiguous events are caused by such agents. This results in a perceptual system strongly biased towards anthropomorphism. Therefore, we tend to assume intention even where there is none. This would have arisen as a survival mechanism. If a lion is about to attack you, you need to react quickly, given its probable intention to kill you. By the time you have realized that the design of its teeth and claws could kill you, you are dead. So, assuming intent, without <u>detailed</u> design analysis or understanding of the physics, has saved your life.

questions.passage:
(A) The scientist made an important <u>point</u> about how our minds work.
(B) She used her finger to <u>point</u> at the animal hiding in the grass.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 point의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ (A) 요점/주장 — (B) 가리키다: (A)는 마음이 작동하는 방식에 관한 중요한 '요점(point)'을 말했다는 뜻, (B)는 손가락으로 동물을 '가리켰다(point at)'는 뜻에 부합 ←정답
❌ ① (A) 뾰족한 끝 — (B) 가리키다: (A)는 '요점'이지 '뾰족한 끝'이 아님
❌ ② (A) 점수 — (B) 가리키다: (A)는 '점수'가 아니라 '요점'
❌ ③ (A) 요점/주장 — (B) 점수: (B)는 '점수'가 아니라 '가리키다'

❌ ① biologist: biologist(생물학자)는 생물을 연구하는 사람이라 정의와 다름

✅ ④ anthropologist: anthropologist(인류학자)는 '인간과 그들의 사회·문화를 과학적으로 연구하는 사람'이라는 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: anthropologist = 인류학자 (본문: The anthropologist Stewart Guthrie)

questions.passage: From an early age, we assign purpose to objects and events, __________ (prefer) this reasoning to random chance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 주절과 동시에 일어나는 동작을 나타내는 분사구문 자리: prefer(동사) → preferring(현재분사)
det.analysis: 빈칸은 앞 문장(we assign purpose ...)에 이어 '~하면서'라는 뜻을 더하는 분사구문 자리예요. 동사 prefer(선호하다)를 현재분사 preferring으로 바꾸면 '무작위적 우연보다 이런 추론을 선호하면서'라는 뜻이 돼요.
det.tip: prefer(동사) → preferring(현재분사: ~을 선호하면서)

questions.passage: However, by __________ (attribute) intention to animals and even objects, we are able to make fast decisions about the likely behaviour of that being.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 전치사 by의 목적어(동명사) 자리: attribute(동사) → attributing(동명사)
det.analysis: 빈칸은 전치사 by 뒤에 오는 자리예요. 전치사 뒤에는 명사나 동명사가 와야 하므로, 동사 attribute(부여하다)를 동명사 attributing으로 바꿔야 해요. by attributing intention = 의도를 부여함으로써.
det.tip: by + 동명사 = ~함으로써 → attributing
